scientific_integrity: The full-domain statements use a renewal-inspection identity, Fourier/Laplace uniqueness, posterior monotone likelihood ratios, Gamma hazard monotonicity, and controlled saddle asymptotics. The shipped checker tests 264 finite parameter diagnostics, which do not establish infinite-domain correctness by themselves.
scientific_limitations: Equilibrium, instantaneous, independent complete resetting of a nondegenerate one-dimensional Brownian particle; Gamma asymptotics for fixed parameters. Existing general conditional-density and Gamma hazard results are explicitly credited. General stochastic-order identifiability theorems could bear on publication priority.
title: Spatial forecasting rigidity and Gamma-clock reversal for Brownian resetting
